defs.def: the highest part or point of sth 顶；顶部；顶端

ex.s: This makes a fun activity for a children’s party; they love feeding the fruit and frozen bananas into the top of the machine and watching the ice cream come out below.
ex.t: 这对儿童派对来说是个有趣的活动；他们喜欢把水果和冷冻香蕉从机器顶端投入，看着冰淇淋从下方出来。

ex.s: This included digging up the road, ____63___ (lay) the track and then building a strong roof over___64___ top.
ex.t: 这包括挖开路面、____63____（铺设）轨道，然后在____64____顶部建造坚固的顶棚。

ex.s: The rolling sea of clouds you see once you are at the top will remind you how tiny we ___57___ (human) are.
ex.t: 一旦你登上山顶，看到的滚滚云海会让你意识到我们人类___57___（human）是多么渺小。

ex.s: Here she picks her top reads.
ex.t: 这里是她挑选的最爱读物。

ex.s: 2. ___69___ Paste the picture at the top of a page and have them write a story about what is happening or what the picture represents.
ex.t: 2. ___69___ 把图片贴在一页顶部，让他们写一个关于正在发生的事或图片所代表之物的故事。

ex.s: Yes, there beneath the leafy top of one tiny carrot was her long-lost wedding ring.
ex.t: 是的，在一棵小胡萝卜绿叶覆盖的顶端下面，是她丢失已久的结婚戒指。

ex.s: At the top of a second page, put the heading “Acts of kindness.” On this one, list all the positive things you’ve done for others.
ex.t: 在第二页的顶部写下标题“善举”。在这一页上，列出你为他人做过的所有积极的事情。

ex.s: If you want to turn over a new leaf, though, one top tip is that it helps to choose a significant date that signals the start of a new “chapter”.
ex.t: 不过，如果你想重新开始，一个顶级建议是：选择一个象征新“章节”开始的重要日期会很有帮助。

ex.s: The terraces are built on the slopes that rise up from the river to the top of the mountains.
ex.t: 梯田建在从河边一直上升到山顶的山坡上。

ex.s: Its unique feature, from which it gets its name, is the bright red skin on the top of its head.
ex.t: 它的独特特征——也是它名字的由来——是头顶上鲜红色的皮肤。

ex.s: The Chinese coach ____32____ Douglas into one of the best gymnasts in the ____33____, helping her skyrocket from an ____34____ member of the national team to the top of the sport.
ex.t: 这位中国教练把道格拉斯____32____培养成了____33____最好的体操运动员之一，帮助她从国家队的一名____34____队员一跃成为这项运动的顶尖选手。

ex.s: A great attitude can bring joy to those around you, or even ____33____ stranger to the top of a mountain.
ex.t: 积极的态度可以给你周围的人带来快乐，甚至能____33____把陌生人送上山顶。

ex.s: This included digging up the road, ____63___(lay) the track and then building a strong roof over___64___ top.
ex.t: 这包括挖开路面、____63____（铺设）轨道，然后在____64____顶部建造坚固的顶棚。

ex.s: Mathematical models have also revealed that food webs may be unstable， where small changes of top predators can lead to big effects throughout entire ecosystems． In the 1960s， scientists proposed that predators at the top of a food web had a surprising amount of control over the size of populations of other species﹣including species they did not directly attack．
ex.t: 数学模型也揭示，食物网可能不稳定，顶级捕食者的微小变化会在整个生态系统引发巨大效应。20世纪60年代，科学家提出，食物网顶端的捕食者对包括它们不直接攻击的物种在内的其他物种种群规模有着惊人的控制力。

ex.s: And unplanned human activities have proved the idea of top﹣down control by top predators to be true． In the ocean， we fished for top predators such as cod on an industrial scale， while on land， we killed off large predators such as wolves． These actions have greatly affected the ecological balance．
ex.t: 而人类无计划的活动已经证明了顶级捕食者自上而下控制的观点是正确的。在海洋中，我们以工业规模捕捞鳕鱼等顶级捕食者，而在陆地上，我们消灭了狼等大型捕食者。这些行为极大地影响了生态平衡。

ex.s: The best of a Kilimanjaro   50  , in my opinion, isn’t reaching the top.
ex.t: 在我看来，乞力马扎罗山最棒的部分___50___，并不在于登顶。

ex.s: In Save Money: Good Food, she visits a different home each week and with the help of chef Matt Tebbutt offers top tips on how to reduce food waste, while preparing recipes for under £5 per family a day.
ex.t: 在《省钱：美味食物》中，她每周走访一户不同的家庭，并在厨师马特·特巴特的帮助下，提供减少食物浪费的顶级建议，同时准备每天每户不到5英镑的食谱。

ex.s: C her strong urge to follow the crowdD. her dream of entering a top university
ex.t: C 她随大流的强烈冲动D. 她进入顶尖大学的梦想

ex.s: （3）What will happen if the populations of top predators in a food web greatly decline？
ex.t: （3）如果食物网中顶级捕食者的种群大幅减少，会发生什么？

ex.s: B．The species they indirectly attack will turn into top predators．
ex.t: B．它们间接攻击的物种会变成顶级捕食者。

ex.s: 46    Companies spend millions hiring top business people.
ex.t: 46 公司花费数百万雇佣顶尖商业人才。

ex.s: Too much praise can backfire and, when given in a way that's insincere, make kids afraid to try new things or take a risk for fear of not being able to stay on top where their parents' praise has put them.
ex.t: 过多的表扬可能适得其反，而且当表扬以不真诚的方式给出时，会让孩子害怕尝试新事物或冒险，担心无法保持在父母表扬把他们放到的那个顶端位置。

ex.s: Americans take the 7___ to the top floor of a building.
ex.t: 美国人乘7____到大楼的顶层。

ex.s: But Sarah,  64  has taken part in shows along with top models, wants 65      (prove) that she has brains as well as beauty.
ex.t: 但曾与顶级模特同台演出的萨拉，想____65____（prove）她既有美貌也有智慧。

ex.s: 69   (surround) the mountain tops, he was reduced to tears.
ex.t: 69  （环绕）山顶，他感动得流下了眼泪。

ex.s: I climbed and climbed． There was nothing but just green bushes and these steps． I had to reach the top!
ex.t: 现在我们生活在一个充满"做不到"的态度的世界里。我们都会跌倒。我们都有疑虑和遗憾。但我们仍然必须攀登，梦想着我们山顶上有什么。怪物可能会出现，或者黑夜将会降临。但永远不要放弃你的梦想！

ex.s: Now we live in a world surrounded by the "can't do" attitudes． We all fall down． We all have doubts and regrets． Still we must climb and dream about what's at the top of our mountain． Monsters may appear or the night will fall． But never ever give up on your dream!
ex.t: 如今我们生活在一个被“做不到”态度包围的世界。我们都会跌倒。我们都有疑虑和悔恨。但我们仍须攀登，梦想山顶的风景。怪物可能出现，夜幕可能降临。但永远不要放弃你的梦想！

ex.s: Here is a picture of Dorothy Woodruff, on her horse, looking down from a hill top: “When the sun slipped behind the mountains, it shed a rosy glow all around them.
ex.t: 这里有一张多萝西·伍德拉夫骑在马上的照片，从山顶俯瞰：当太阳滑到山后，它在他们四周洒下玫瑰色的光辉。

ex.s: We've all known people who run out of steam before they reach life's halfway mark． I'm not talking about those who fail to get to the top． We can't all get there． I'm talking about people who have stopped learning on growing because they have adopted the fixed attitudes and opinions that all too often come with passing years．
ex.t: 我们都认识这样的人，他们在到达人生的中点之前就失去了动力。我说的不是那些没能登上顶峰的人。我们不可能都到达顶峰。我说的是那些停止学习和成长的人，因为他们接受了那些常常伴随岁月流逝而来的固定态度和观念。

defs.def: the upper flat surface of sth 表面；上面
the highest or most important rank or position 最高的级别；最重要的职位

ex.s: Cao ___67___ (walk) through 34 countries in six continents and in 2016, he reached the top of Kilimanjaro, Africa’s ___68___ (high) mountain.
ex.t: 曹___67___ (walk)徒步走过六大洲34个国家，2016年他登上了非洲最高峰乞力马扎罗山___68___ (high)。

defs.def: the end of a street, table, etc. that is farthest away from you or from where you usually come to it 尽头；远端

ex.s: It’s the only Thai restaurant that ranks among the top 10 of the word’s 50 best restaurants list.
ex.t: 它是唯一一家跻身全球50家最佳餐厅榜单前十的泰国餐厅。

defs.def: a thing that you put on the end of sth to close it 帽；盖；塞
a piece of clothing worn on the upper part of the body 上衣
the leaves of a plant that is grown mainly for its root （根菜作物的）茎叶

ex.s: Diets have changed in China – and so too has its top crop.
ex.t: 中国的饮食发生了变化——它最主要的作物也随之改变。

defs.def: （用于款额后）最高额

ex.s: How did Dickens get to the top?
ex.t: 狄更斯是如何登上巅峰的？

defs.def: a person or thing of the best quality 最优秀的人；最好的东西；精华
a child's toy that spins on a point when it is turned round very quickly by hand or by a string 陀螺
on the highest point or surface 在上面；在顶部
in a leading position or in control 处于领先地位；控制局面
in addition 另外；加之
on, over or covering sth/sb 在 … 上面；在 … 上方；覆盖着

ex.s: Samuel, the tallest boy in our class, ______ easily reach the books on the top shelf.
ex.t: 在20世纪50年代的美国，大多数家里只有一部电话，无线电话当时还没有____。

ex.s: My friends checked and came back shouting, “Amy, you got the main role! ” Sure enough, my name was at the top.
ex.t: 我的朋友们查看后跑回来喊道："艾米，你拿到主角了！"果然，我的名字在最上面。

ex.s: This is how everyone learned to read． We would start off with sentences， then paragraphs， and then stories． It seemed an unending journey， but even as a six﹣year﹣old girl I realized that knowing how to read could open many doors． When mom said， "The C﹣A﹣N﹣D﹣Y is hidden on the top shelf，" I knew where the candy was． My progress in reading raised my curiosity， and I wanted to know everything． I often found myself telling my mom to drive more slowly， so that I could read all of the road signs we passed．
ex.t: 每个人都是这样学会阅读的。我们从句子开始，然后是段落，再然后是故事。这似乎是一段永无止境的旅程，但即使作为一个六岁的女孩，我也意识到学会阅读能打开许多扇门。当妈妈说：“C-A-N-D-Y藏在最上面的架子上”时，我知道糖果在哪里。我在阅读上的进步激发了我的好奇心，我想知道一切。我经常叫妈妈开慢一点，这样我就能读出我们路过的所有路标。

ex.s: Reaching as far as the eye can see, these terraces cover tall mountains, often from the bottom to the very top.
ex.t: 这些梯田延绵至目力所及之处，覆盖着座座高山，常常从山脚一直延伸到山顶。

ex.s: We could also say An eagle flew over the mountains, whose tops were covered in snow.
ex.t: 我们也可以说：一只鹰飞过群山，山顶被雪覆盖着。

ex.s: One morning I ___36___ a lost lamb when I was in the top field，near where a motorway cuts through my land.
ex.t: 一天早晨，当我在靠近高速公路穿过我土地的高处田地时，我___36___一只迷路的小羊。

ex.s: Even though Britain has a reputation for less-than-impressive cuisine, it is producing more top class chefs who appear frequently on our television screens and whose recipe books frequently top the best seller lists.
ex.t: 尽管英国以平庸的烹饪闻名，但它正在培养出更多一流厨师，他们频繁出现在电视屏幕上，其食谱书也经常登上畅销榜榜首。

defs.def: in addition to sth 除 … 之外
very close to sth/sb 紧挨着；与 … 紧靠着

ex.s: Unexpectedly, I’m face-to-face with the gorilla, who begins screaming at    62    top of her lungs.
ex.t: 出乎意料地，我与那只大猩猩面对面，它开始___62____声嘶力竭地尖叫。

defs.def: in control of a situation 控制着；掌握着
highest in position, rank or degree （位置、级别或程度）最高的
very good 很好的；极棒的；顶呱呱的
to be higher than a particular amount 高于，超过（某一数量）

ex.s: On August 5, the number of postcards exchanged by members topped 31 million.
ex.t: 8月5日会员之间交换的明信片数量超过了3100万张。

ex.s: The results are mixed For football and basketball，adding talented players to a team proves a good method，but only up to the point where 70% of the players are top talent；above that level, the team’s performance begins to decline.
ex.t: 对于足球和篮球来说，效果不一：为球队增添有天赋的球员被证明是个好办法，但仅限于70%的球员都是顶尖人才的程度；超过这一水平，球队的表现就开始下滑。

ex.s: Completing many courses no longer brings out the feeling of success because more than four AP classes per year is a norm set by top universities.
ex.t: 完成许多课程不再带来成功感，因为每年超过四门AP课已是顶尖大学设定的常态。

ex.s: （1）What made the author start to climb up the stairs to the mountain top？（no more than 5 words）
ex.t: （4）你如何理解最后一段中划线的句子？（不超过5个词）

ex.s: （2）Why did the author hurry back home without reaching the top of the mountain？ Give two reasons．（no more than 15 words）
ex.t: （2）作者为什么没有到达山顶就匆忙回家？给出两个原因。（不超过15个词）

defs.def: to be in the highest position on a list because you are the most successful, important, etc. 居 … 之首；为 … 之冠
to put sth on the top of sth else 把（某物）放在 … 的上面

ex.s: Sports team owners spend millions of dollars attracting top talent
ex.t: 另一种可能性是，当一个团队有很多人才时，有些球员可能会减少努力。

ex.s: But she expects using the chemical in some kind of industrial process — not simply “millions of worms thrown on top of the plastic.”
ex.t: 但她期望将这种化学物质用于某种工业流程中——而不是简单地把“数百万条虫子扔在塑料上”。

ex.s: A.as clear as day B. off the top of my head
ex.t: A. 一清二楚  B. 不假思索

defs.def: to say or do sth that is better, funnier, more impressive, etc. than sth that sb else has said or done in the past 胜过，优于，压倒（前人所做）
to kill yourself deliberately 自杀
to reach the highest point of a hill, etc. 到达山顶；达到顶端

ex.s: It is criticized by top chefs.
ex.t: 他们曾合作出演《爵士时代》。

defs.def: to fill a container that already has some liquid in it with more liquid 装满，注满（未满的容器）
to increase the amount of sth to the level you want or need 补足；将 … 增加到所需的量
